title: Treatment of Infertility in Women With Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
brief_summary: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a common endocrine disorder affecting up to 10% of women. The primary symptoms of PCOS are menstrual irregularities, increased body and facial hair, acne, and infertility. This study will test a combination of medications in women with PCOS to determine which works best to overcome infertility.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Eight or fewer menstrual cycles in the past year or intermenstrual periods of 45 days or longer
* Elevated testosterone level
* Good general health
* Sperm concentration in partner of 20 million/ml or greater
* Ability to have intercourse 2-3 times per week
* One functional fallopian tube and normal uterine cavity
